race.comment: AZUKI (7) looks the top contender after two solid fourths in stronger Queensland form lines. Latest run he finished fourth at Ipswich on heavy ground. Has been racing consistently this season, gets the winning rider back with the claim, and the move to this level gives him a workable platform. MAGIC MOZ (10) is the main danger after closing from well back for fourth at the Sunshine Coast, having been beaten just over half a length as favourite at Ipswich the run prior when she had difficulty getting clear running. The new 1600m is the question, but her recent form reads strongly. OUR GRECIA GIRL (6) was plain first-up at Eagle Farm, yet her Waverley debut win on soft ground showed enough to respect her back in easier company. Each way contender. RISK FOR REWARD (12) rises from a BM45 win at Murwillumbah, but he is a track-and-trip winner, gets weight relief and carries a home-course profile strong enough to keep him in the mix.
